title: Settings
subtitle: Manage the app, your parts inventory and notifications

general.title: General settings
general.subtitle: Interface language, start screen, launch at startup, Crossout logs, updates and app data.

logs.title: Crossout logs
logs.subtitle: The folder that contains combat.log. Use it when the app cannot find the logs on its own.
logs.empty: No folder selected. It is usually .../Targem/Crossout/logs.

language.title: Interface language
language.subtitle: The interface uses the selected language. In Ukrainian, part names, market items and weapon names stay in Russian.

startScreen.title: Start screen
startScreen.subtitle: What opens after loading. Craft is the build screen, Stats is battle logs.

startup.title: Startup
startup.subtitle: The app can open together with the system.
startup.openAtLoginHint: The app opens after you sign in.
startup.unavailable: Launch at startup only works in the installed version of the app.

updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: The app checks GitHub for new versions.
updates.autoHint: If disabled, you can still check manually.
updates.availableHint: Download it now or install it on the next launch.
updates.downloadingHint: The download continues in the background — you can keep using the app.
updates.downloadedNow: Restart the app to install version {{version}}.
updates.downloadedLater: The update will be installed automatically on the next launch.
updates.unavailable: Updates are not available in this build
updates.unavailableHint: Update checks only work in the installed version of the app.

data.title: Data & cache
data.subtitle: Local data is stored only on this computer.
data.clearCacheHint: Resets market filters, recipes, required parts and the last solution. Inventory settings are kept.
data.clearCacheConfirm: Clear the data cache? The app will restart.
data.resetHint: Restores the inventory, analog criteria, notifications and start screen to their defaults.
data.resetConfirm: Reset all settings? This cannot be undone.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: XO Craft Solution helps you build optimal crafts.
about.author: Author: SABOTAGE

inventory.title: Parts inventory
inventory.subtitle: The field shows the maximum quantity. Lower it to the amount you actually have.
inventory.enableHint: When off, the inventory does not affect calculations — maximum quantities are used.
inventory.enabledNotice: Inventory is on. Calculations use the quantities you set; unchanged parts use the game maximum.
inventory.disabledNotice: Inventory is off. Your quantities are saved but do not affect calculations right now.
inventory.clearHint: Every quantity returns to its maximum value.
inventory.clearConfirm: Reset all quantities? Every part will return to its maximum.
inventory.empty: You haven't changed any quantities yet. Find parts and set your actual stock.
inventory.error: Could not load the parts list
inventory.listHint: Lower the quantity to your actual stock. 0 excludes the part, the maximum is the default.

analog.title: Analog criteria
analog.subtitle: Set the maximum stat deviations at which a part is considered a suitable analog.
analog.powerHint: Maximum power score difference between the original and an analog.
analog.weightHint: Allowed part weight deviation to keep the build balanced.
analog.durabilityHint: How much less durable an analog may be than the original part.
analog.findHint: Pick a part to see analogs that fit the configured tolerances.
analog.noMatches: No analogs fit the configured tolerances
analog.sameCategory: Only parts from the same category are matched.
analog.error: Could not load the parts list

market.title: Market & notifications
market.subtitle: Sound and notification preferences for market activity.
market.soundHint: Played when a watchlist rule triggers.
market.priceDropHint: Alert when a watchlist price or lot rule on the market page triggers.
market.backgroundHint: Play notifications even when the window is minimized.
market.customSoundHint: MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A or FLAC, up to 10 MB. The file is stored only on this computer.
market.customSoundTooLarge: The file is too large (max 10 MB)
market.followedHint: Add parts to your followed list on the market page.
